## What changed

- Publish under the `latest` dist-tag, which is the only one OIDC can set.

Trusted Publishing mints a **publish-scoped** credential: the tag chosen at
publish time is the only one CI can ever apply, and a follow-up
`npm dist-tag add` is answered with a 401. Publishing under a per-release
`fork-N` tag instead stranded `latest` on whichever build shipped first.
